items.title: google-deepmind/mujoco
items.contentSnippet:
Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
https://mujoco.org

  
 
             
 
MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment.
 
This repository is maintained by Google DeepMind.
 
MuJ

items.title: Show HN: Tinctile – hex grid color puzzle that you solve using counts
items.contentSnippet:
A coloring puzzle on a hex board with numbers telling you how many of each color go in a line. What's interesting is that were it a square grid you'd need additional clues on the board. The fact that three lines pass through each hex cell makes it possible to start with a completely empty board, which is pretty neat.

items.title: Show HN: Cloakroom – Keeps secrets away from agents
items.contentSnippet:
Cloakroom is an open-source privacy tool that masks secrets and sensitive data from AI agents. It swaps real values for placeholders, then swaps them back to the originals locally.
I was trying to build a full on local LLM setup on my machine, but the local models were not up to the mark (at least, not yet).
